title: Is AI 'one big bubble?' Behind the tech selloff
summary: Investors are selling off AI-related stocks as doubts are starting to surface over whether the massive spending on AI is worth the investment or whether "it's one big bubble."
contentText:
Investors are selling off AI-related stocks as doubts are starting to surface over whether the massive spending on AI is worth the investment or whether "it's one big bubble."

(Image credit: Chris Hondros/Getty Images)
